name: influencer.list
description: The roster of every company the caller is a member of, by name: each person with their category, status and notes, their accounts in order (the first is the one they are known by; a picture is our own copy's path on the core) and the ids of the company's brands they are linked to.
sql: select brandbase.influencer_json(i.id) as result from brandbase.influencers i order by lower(i.name), i.slug
